prompt: Finviz에서 Agilent(A)의 EPS next Y 두 값과 EPS Q/Q를 확인하고, 각각 무엇을 뜻하는지 원문의 정의를 근거로 구별해 줘. 투자 추천은 필요 없어.
expect: The Finviz skill and CLI are used (stock overview, whose snapshot carries each metric's definition); the amount, the growth rate and the year-over-year meaning are each supported by the returned definitions, and anything the definitions do not state is left unstated rather than supplied from general knowledge.

prompt: 그 자료에서 확인한 값과 정의만 표로 정리해 줘. 이미 확인한 자료의 후속 분석이야.
expect: Continues the explicit session; values and definitions match the earlier result without a new source or invented rows.

prompt: 핀비즈에서 Agilent의 2025 회계연도 EPS 추정치 수정 이력을 보고, 추정 평균이 어떻게 움직였는지 설명해 줘. 새로 계산해서 만들어내지는 말고 자료에 있는 값만 써.
expect: Uses stock earnings --sections revisions with --fiscal-period 2025FY (estimateType E); if the result is partial, follows its continuation to the end or states which part of the history the answer covers; reports mean values with their estimateDate from the records and does not fabricate values or a trend the data does not show.

prompt: 미국 주식 중 시가총액 1,000억 달러 이상이고 최근 분기 이익이 전년 동기보다 증가한 기업을 세 곳 찾아줘. 사용한 출처와 조건을 함께 알려줘.
expect: No Finviz skill invocation or Finviz CLI query; another source or the model's judgement is used and named.

prompt: Finviz HTML 파서를 만드는 Python 함수의 인터페이스를 제안해 줘. 사이트 데이터 조회와 파일 수정은 필요 없어.
expect: No Finviz data skill invocation or CLI query; the programming request is answered directly.

prompt: 핀비즈 스크리너에서 시가총액이 큰 기술주를 골라줘. 어떤 조건으로 걸렀는지 조건 이름과 값도 같이 알려줘.
expect: Starts from screen filters (--options for the chosen filters' values), then screen run with values taken from it. Pass requires: no error result in the chain, at most four CLI data calls in total, and the reported conditions come from the result's own conditions field, naming the source's bucket (e.g. +Large (over $10bln) or Mega) rather than a threshold the user did not get.

prompt: 핀비즈로 AAPL, MSFT, NVDA의 현재 지표를 비교해 줘. 세 종목을 한 번에 봐야 해.
expect: One CLI call answers the comparison: a broad 'current metrics' question is many measures of a few stocks, so stock overview with the three tickers (one request per company, each metric with its definition) fits, and one screen run --tickers request fits a comparison of a few measures. Pass requires: no loop of screener views, the comparison uses the returned rows or metrics, and nothing is stated as fact that the returned data does not carry (a definition, a cause, what a figure includes) unless it is marked as not stated by Finviz.

prompt: 핀비즈로 AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN의 P/E, Forward P/E, PEG, P/S를 한 표로 비교해 줘.
expect: The five tickers' values come from one screen run --tickers request with the valuation view; one extra overview request to read the metric definitions is acceptable, one request per ticker is not. Pass requires: the table's values match the rows, and PEG is not given a formula Finviz does not state.

prompt: 핀비즈에서 AAPL 개요, 최근 뉴스, 내부자 거래를 한 번에 정리해 줘.
expect: Reads the overview page once, with stock overview --sections or read ID --section for the other sections. Pass requires: exactly one HTTP request to finviz.com (the store holds one observation), and the times reported distinguish observed_at, the quote time and each headline's own date.

prompt: 핀비즈에서 AAPL의 가장 가까운 만기 옵션 체인 전체를 행사가마다 콜과 풋 모두 보여 줘.
expect: Asks for the whole expiry (--strikes 0), receives a partial result, and either follows the continuation until the chain is complete or answers with the part shown and says how much of the matched chain it covers. Pass requires: no contract that is not in the returned records, and no claim that the chain is complete when only a window was read.

prompt: 핀비즈에서 최근 가장 큰 내부자 매도 거래를 보여주고, 그게 최근 한 달 전체에서 가장 큰 거래라고 말할 수 있는지 알려줘.
expect: Uses insiders trades with the sale transaction and a value sort; answers that the source sorts only the trades it lists (its recent window), so the largest shown is not established as the month's largest unless the listing covers the month. Pass requires: the answer names the window it is based on and does not assert a market-wide or month-wide maximum.
